name: One Line
summary: A single warm-black ink line that never leaves the paper: it thickens on its turns and thins on its runs, the camera follows the hidden pen and pulls back to reveal one finished picture, one stretch of the line carries the only colour, and a connected script writes the title in empty paper.
suits: reveals where small moments add up to one picture

palette.use: the warm white page: nearly the whole frame
the line (warm black), the title and the words
the words at 84% of the line's ink (proposed hex for ink at 84%)
the one coloured stretch of the line, used once (here blue: light, sky); kept in the final picture (proposed hex; the source's demo uses red #b3332b for love)
the source's accent (love, danger), for a film where the one stretch means that

type.case: sentence; caps only for the end card's style name
type.emphasis: the one coloured stretch of the line; the stop

motion.exit: the line moves on (a morph into the next picture); words fade over 0.45 s

banned: a whiteboard explainer: no hand, no marker, no erasing, no text-heavy boards
ink wash: no tones, no brush blooms
line-art animation with cuts and many strokes: one line, no cuts
fills, shading, a second line weight, background art
the pen lifting, or the pen being drawn (only its shadow and contact)
a second accent colour, or the accent on more than one stretch
stray connectors that read as wrinkles; lines drawn closer than 5 px (they braid)
copying a famous continuous-line character or illustration
